turns.name: Alice
turns.text: This Gen-Audio briefing explains spectrogram cubes. A cube is not a flat spectrogram. It is a spatial stack with four honest layers: signal, tonality, confidence, and quality.

turns.name: Frank
turns.text: Signal is the raw energy surface across time and frequency. Tonality tracks formant and harmonic structure. Confidence marks how stable the estimate is. Quality is the inverse-HDR publish score, not a beauty filter.

turns.name: Alice
turns.text: Gen-Audio builds cubes from real Library WAVs. When a clip synthesizes on kokoro-onnx, the board binds cube JSON and PNG to that clip. Fixture theater badges clear. The Cube3D livetile must say Library, never Fixture, once bound.

turns.name: Frank
turns.text: Benchmark context: misaki to kokoro led the inverse-HDR ranking, then dayour kokoro, then kokoro-onnx. Magpie and VibeVoice stayed near flat when they could not run. Honesty means unavailable paths stay empty tiles.

turns.name: Alice
turns.text: On the desktop, Agent means persona: Anton, Alice, Khortana, Rocky, Sensei, Optimus Timelarp. Voice means the TTS model: kokoro-onnx, dayour kokoro, misaki to kokoro. Up to eight agents can share one generation track.

turns.name: Frank
turns.text: Optimus Timelarp is the gating persona. Tone assertive. Purpose gating and harden. Domain product stamps. Traits decisive, honest, screenshot-proof, and AP-7 hard kill. Flip the VoiceProfile card for full schema, refs, and two-D plus three-D spectrogram hooks.

turns.name: Alice
turns.text: Floating playback keeps play, pause, scrub, time, and title visible while audio runs. The viewport border shifts from idle teal to amber playing chrome so operators always see active transport.

turns.name: Frank
turns.text: MCP and ACP form the atomic control plane. UI navigation tools, library tools, and voice-profile tools stay product-only. No SendKeys theater. No LiveKit until F-gates are firm green.

turns.name: Alice
turns.text: This clip itself is a real kokoro-onnx render wired into Library. If you hear it, the tile should show a matching cube with signal, tonality, confidence, and quality. That is the Gen-Audio contract.

turns.name: Frank
turns.text: Closing: cubes measure, they do not invent. Fixture tones stay labeled Fixture. Library-bound cubes say Library. Optimus Timelarp stamps only from screenshot proof and tip SHAs. End of cube briefing.
